parameters.name: AttributeFilters
parameters.description: The entity attribute filter conditions. Multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. Multiple values within the same filter condition have an OR relationship.

sub_parameters.name: Values
sub_parameters.description: The list of filter attribute values.

parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The comment filter. Performs token matching.

parameters.name: CustomAttributeFilters
parameters.description: The custom attribute filter conditions. Multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. Multiple values within the same filter condition have an OR relationship. Only ENUM custom attributes are supported.

sub_parameters.name: Values
sub_parameters.description: The list of filter attribute values.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The entity name filter. Performs keyword-contains matching.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response.
